mapper.sql: AND IFNULL(s.opted_out, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.ignored_count, 0) < #{maxIgnored} AND (s.last_sent_at IS NULL OR s.last_sent_at < #{sentBefore}) AND (s.last_evaluated_at IS NULL OR s.last_evaluated_at < #{evalBefore}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM push_device d WHERE d.member_id = m.id AND d.enabled = 1)

GREATEST(IFNULL(m.login_time, '1970-01-01'), IFNULL(CAST(g.last_checkin_date AS DATETIME), '1970-01-01'), IFNULL((SELECT MAX(rs.started_at) FROM roam_session rs WHERE rs.member_id = m.id), '1970-01-01'))
mapper.select: SELECT s.member_id AS memberId, s.last_sent_at AS lastSent, s.awaiting_return AS awaiting, s.ignored_count AS ignored, AS lastActive FROM growth_winback_state s JOIN ums_member m ON m.id = s.member_id LEFT JOIN player_growth g ON g.member_id = m.id WHERE s.last_sent_at IS NOT NULL AND (s.awaiting_return = 1 OR s.ignored_count > 0) ORDER BY s.last_sent_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_winback_state SET awaiting_return = #{awaiting}, ignored_count = #{ignored}, update_time = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO growth_winback_state (member_id, update_time) VALUES (#{memberId}, NOW())
mapper.update: INSERT INTO growth_winback_state (member_id, last_evaluated_at, update_time) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_evaluated_at = VALUES(last_evaluated_at)

UPDATE growth_winback_state SET last_sent_at = #{prevSent}, awaiting_return = #{prevAwaiting}, sent_total = GREATEST(sent_total - 1, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND last_sent_at = #{now}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_winback_log (member_id, trigger_code, ref, outcome, devices, create_time) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{trigger}, #{ref}, #{outcome}, #{devices}, #{now})

INSERT INTO growth_winback_state (member_id, opted_out, opted_out_at, update_time) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{optedOut}, IF(#{optedOut} = 1, #{now}, NULL), #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE opted_out = VALUES(opted_out), opted_out_at = VALUES(opted_out_at), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT LEFT(geohash7, 5) FROM roam_fog_tile WHERE member_id = #{memberId} LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.name, a.latitude AS lat, a.longitude AS lng, a.club_id AS clubId, a.start_date AS startDate FROM cms_activity a WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.publish_status = 1 AND a.del_flag = 0 AND a.cancel_time IS NULL AND a.start_date >= #{from} AND a.start_date < #{to} AND (a.club_id IS NULL OR a.club_id = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club c WHERE c.id = a.club_id AND c.del_flag = 0)) ORDER BY a.start_date LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT club_id FROM club_member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 1 AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 200
SELECT id, invite_user_id AS inviteUserId, phone, status, del_flag AS delFlag, create_time AS createTime FROM ums_member WHERE id = #{memberId}
SELECT invitee_member_id AS inviteeId, inviter_member_id AS inviterId, status, reason, create_time AS createTime FROM growth_invite_reward WHERE invitee_member_id = #{inviteeId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM growth_invite_reward WHERE granted_phone_hash = #{phoneHash}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM growth_invite_device WHERE device_hash IN #{h}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM growth_invite_reward WHERE inviter_member_id = #{inviterId} AND status = 'GRANTED' AND create_time >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM growth_invite_reward WHERE inviter_member_id = #{inviterId} AND status = 'GRANTED'
SELECT token FROM push_device WHERE member_id = #{memberId} LIMIT 20

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN decision = 'ACCEPT' AND IFNULL(simulated, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clean, SUM(CASE WHEN decision <> 'ACCEPT' OR IFNULL(simulated, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged FROM location_trust_fix WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND session_id = #{sessionId}

INSERT IGNORE INTO growth_invite_device (device_hash, invitee_member_id, create_time) VALUES (#{deviceHash}, #{inviteeId}, #{now})
